paragraphs: Shabbatai bar Marinos. He came to Babylonia; they gave him neither a business opportunity nor food. He said they descended from the mixed multitude: Beitzah 32b. Shabbatai son of R' Marinos came before R' Hiyya: Bava Metzia 17a.
